stem:
The players on a basketball team record the number of hours they each practice in one week. The data are shown in the dot plot.

Hours Practiced

Each ● represents 1 player.

What is the difference between the greatest and least number of hours practiced?
visual_elements: dot plot with points at: 0.5 (1 dot), 1 (3 dots), 1.5 (5 dots), 2 (3 dots), 2.5 (1 dot), 3 (4 dots), 3.5 (1 dot), 4 (1 dot), 4.5 (1 dot)
